div.l: A semely man . oure hoost was with alle .
For to ben a marchall . in a lordis halle .
A large man he was . with eyen stepe .
A fairer burgeis . is ther non in chepe .
Bolde of his speche . ⁊and wys ⁊and well taught .
And of manhode . hym lacked right nought .
¶ Eke ther to he was . right a mery man .
And after soper . to pleien he bigan .
And spak of myrthe . amonge other thynges
Whan that we had made . oure rekenynges .
And seide thus . now lordyngis trewly .
Ye ben to me . welcome right hertely .
For be my trouthe . if that I schall not lye .
I saugh nought this yere . so mery a companye .
At ones in this herberwe . as is now .
Fayne wolde I don yow . merthe wiste I how .
And of myrthe . I am right now bithought .
To don yow ese . ⁊and it schall coste nought .
Ye gon to Cauntirbury . god yow spede .
The blisfull martir . quyte you you mede .
And well I wote . as ye gon bi the weie .
Ye schapen you . to talken ⁊and to pleie .
For trewly coūmfort . ne myrthe is non .
To ride bi the weie . dombe as eny ston .
And therfore wole I . maken you disporte .
As I seide erst . ⁊and don yow som comforte .
And if you liketh alle . bi oon assent .
For to stonden . at my Iugement .
And for to wirken . as I schall you seie .
¶ To morow . whan we riden bi the weie .
Now be my fadris soule . that is deed .
But ye be mery . I woll yeue yow myn heed .
Holdeth vp youre hondes . wtith oute more speche .
Oure counseile . was nought longe for to seche .
Vs thought it was not worth . to make it wys .
And graūnted hym . with oute more a vys .
And bad hym saye . his verdite as hym leste .
Lordynges qd he . now herkeneth for the beste .
But take it nought . I praie you in disdeyne .
This is the poynte . to speke schort ⁊and pleyne .
That eche of you . to schort with oure weie .
In this viage . schall telle tales tweie .
To Cauntirbury warde . I mene it so .
And homward . he schall tellen other two .
Of auentures . that whilom haue befalle .
And whiche of yow . that berith hym best of alle .
That is to seyn . that telleth in this caas .
